# Independent external-validator controls (#729)

- `pdfa-1b.pdf`: independently assembled 904-byte blank-page PDF/A-1b from
  the #719 audit. It was not generated by oxidize-pdf. veraPDF 1.30.3 accepts it
  with 129 passed rules / 93 passed checks; qpdf 11.9.0 accepts its structure.
- `non-pdfa.pdf`: the hand-assembled 335-byte PDF from #722. qpdf accepts its
  structure; veraPDF rejects PDF/A-1b conformance (missing required XMP metadata).
- `valid.xml`: authentic successful veraPDF 1.30.3 report retained from the
  audit. `invalid.xml`: freshly captured nonconforming report for non-pdfa.pdf.
  Paths and timestamps are original evidence; parser tests do not depend on them.

Reproduce from the repository root with real tools:

```
qpdf --check oxidize-pdf-core/tests/fixtures/issue_729/pdfa-1b.pdf
verapdf --format xml --flavour 1b oxidize-pdf-core/tests/fixtures/issue_729/pdfa-1b.pdf
verapdf --format xml --flavour 1b oxidize-pdf-core/tests/fixtures/issue_729/non-pdfa.pdf
cargo test -p oxidize-pdf --test issue_729_external_validators_test -- --ignored
```

Malformed/inconsistent XML controls are mutations of the captured reports, not
claims of output actually emitted by veraPDF. Wrapper process tests separately
exercise exit errors, unavailable executables and supported argument handling.
